name: mcu-quay
description: MCU Quay (芯埠): Node.js/TypeScript MCU relay service and React operator console

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:server && npm run typecheck:web
scripts.build:web: npm run typecheck:web && vite build --config frontend/vite.config.ts
scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:web
scripts.test: npm run typecheck:web && npm run build:server && node --test dist/tests/*.test.js
scripts.test:coverage: npm run typecheck:web && npm run build:server && node --test --experimental-test-coverage dist/tests/*.test.js
